verdict.rationale: Sumsub's liveness docs explicitly name defenses against deepfakes, AI-generated images, paper masks, photos of screens, and dolls, going beyond generic marketing language (sumsub-docs-12) and includes a review workflow for liveness results (sumsub-docs-13). However, there is no explicit mention of 'camera injection' attacks or deeper technical detail on how each attack vector is detected. missing for 10: explicit camera-injection attack defenses, technical/algorithmic detail on detection methods, independent validation of these claims.
